thread:
yana: FYI I started a q5 bring-up for zephyr-v1 on staging and our short multilingual sample (ja/zh/ko) shows a small but consistent chrF/bleu regression. example points to token detok weirdness around ZWJ/ideographic-space combos. sharing repro and a tiny failing sample.

yana: repro:
```
./eval_short --model=zephyr-v1 --quant=q5 --locales=ja,zh,ko \
  --dataset=short-locals-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=11
```

yana: metric snapshot (float32 -> q5):
```
ja  ble u: 29.5 -> 26.0   chrf: 46.2 -> 41.8
zh  ble u: 27.8 -> 24.6   chrf: 44.0 -> 39.1
ko  ble u: 28.9 -> 26.1   chrf: 45.6 -> 42.0
```

yana: failing sample (zh):
src: "今日は、テスト。"
ref: 今日は、テスト。
q5_out: 今日は、テス。  (missing ト token; extra period moved)

cheng: tokenization debug against embedded tokenizer in the two builds:
```
float tokenize("今日は、テスト。") -> ["今日","\u306f","\u3001","\u30c6\u30b9","\u30c8","\u3002"]
q5  tokenize("今日は、テスト。") -> ["今日","","\u306f","\u3001","\u30c6","\u30b9","\u3002"]
```
cheng: q5 run inserts an empty token and splits the katakana pair across tokens. detok after generation collapses incorrectly and we lose ト.

sato: build metadata: q5 image built 2026-03-20 with tokenizers v1.9.3; float image built 2026-03-21 with tokenizers v1.9.5. looks like a tokenizer patch landed between them.

hiro: does the model bundle embed a tokenizer checksum? if not, packaging could pick different runtime libs at runtime. we should add a strict checksum validation in the model loader.

deploy-bot: Canary q5 rollout started: rollout_id=rl-2026-1788, hosts updated 0/3 -> 3/3, metadata: tokenizers/hash: aa11bb -> cc22dd. Use `deploy-bot tail rl-2026-1788` for logs.

yana: short-term mitigation: adding a detok postfilter that removes empty tokens and attempts to rejoin common split pairs (katakana digraphs, kanji ligatures) before scoring. ugly but fast.

cheng: i can run a bisect across tokenizers v1.9.* to land the offending patch and propose a microfix. also will add unit tests for katakana adjacency to catch regressions.

yana: thanks. i'll attach repro artifacts and failing samples to the GH issue and iterate on the detok filter on the canary. will post updated metrics once we rerun.
